about: Old and new keys. One mod cell (9073) has monster_art and old mon_spr: the art wins what it lists, the old key gives what it does not list (a phase it has no block for, a monster type it has no block for). Across mods: harness_own_art (old keys only) still gives spr_sp_drip_1 in the same run, and an old mon_spr patch of a vanilla cell loses to a monster_art patch of it whichever loads first (a_old < art_cell < old_late by folder name: cell 2 gets the old patch first, cell 1 gets it last). Spec: a cell's monster_art beats its old mon_spr whatever the load order.
